page=canvas(size=(100 mm,80 mm),background="#ffffff")
shade=linear_gradient(start=(0,0),end=(1,1),stops=[(0,"#ff0000"),(1,"#0000ff")])
spot=radial_gradient(center=(0.5,0.5),radius=0.6,stops=[(0,"#ffffff"),(1,"#00aa66")])
hole=path(commands=[move_to(0 mm,0 mm),line_to(20 mm,0 mm),line_to(20 mm,20 mm),line_to(0 mm,20 mm),close(),move_to(5 mm,5 mm),line_to(15 mm,5 mm),line_to(15 mm,15 mm),line_to(5 mm,15 mm),close()],fill_rule=evenodd,fill=shade,border_color="#111111",border_width=0.4 mm,border_dash=[2 mm,1 mm,0.5 mm,1 mm],border_dash_offset=0.5 mm,border_cap=round,border_join=bevel,border_miter_limit=3)
page.add(hole,target=page.top_left,offset=(5 mm,5 mm))
curve=path(commands=[move_to(0 mm,0 mm),quad_to(5 mm,-3 mm,10 mm,0 mm),cubic_to(13 mm,3 mm,17 mm,3 mm,20 mm,0 mm),arc_to(5 mm,5 mm,0 deg,false,true,30 mm,0 mm)],fill="none",border_color="#333333",border_width=0.6 mm)
page.add(curve,target=page.top_left,offset=(35 mm,8 mm))
page.add(polygon(points=[(0 mm,0 mm),(8 mm,0 mm),(4 mm,8 mm)],fill=spot),target=page.top_left,offset=(5 mm,30 mm))
page.add(polyline(points=[(0 mm,0 mm),(8 mm,4 mm),(12 mm,0 mm)],line_color="#0088aa",line_width=0.8 mm),target=page.top_left,offset=(18 mm,30 mm))
page.add(arc(radius=6 mm,start=0 deg,end=240 deg),target=page.top_left,offset=(36 mm,30 mm))
page.add(star(points=5,outer_radius=6 mm,inner_radius=3 mm,fill="#f0a000"),target=page.top_left,offset=(52 mm,30 mm))
page.add(sector(radius=6 mm,start=0 deg,end=110 deg,fill="#a000cc"),target=page.top_left,offset=(68 mm,30 mm))
page.add(ring(outer_radius=6 mm,inner_radius=3 mm,fill="#228822"),target=page.top_left,offset=(82 mm,30 mm))
label=text(spans=[span("Red",color="#ff0000"),span("Blue",color="#0000ff")],font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf",font_size=12 pt)
page.add(label,target=page.top_left,offset=(5 mm,55 mm))

page=canvas(size=(100 mm,60 mm))
box=rect(size=(12 mm, 10 mm),fill="#00aaaa")
first=page.add(box,target=page.top_left,offset=(5 mm,5 mm))
spare=page.add(box,target=page.top_left,offset=(60 mm,5 mm))
stem=page.add(line(dx=14 mm,dy=6 mm,line_width=2 mm),target=page.top_left,offset=(25 mm,7 mm))
merged=page.fuse(first,stem,points=(first.middle_right,stem.start),bridge_width=2 mm,junction=miter,fill="#008899",border_color="none")
after=page.add(box,target=merged.bottom_left,offset=(0 mm,3 mm))

page=canvas(size=(100 mm,60 mm))
box=rect(size=(12 mm, 10 mm),fill="#00aaaa")
first=page.add(box,target=page.top_left,offset=(5 mm,5 mm))
spare=page.add(box,target=page.top_left,offset=(60 mm,5 mm))
stem=page.add(line(dx=14 mm,dy=6 mm,line_width=2 mm),target=page.top_left,offset=(25 mm,7 mm))
merged=page.fuse(first,stem,points=(first.middle_right,stem.start),bridge_width=2 mm,junction=bevel,fill="#008899",border_color="none")
after=page.add(box,target=merged.bottom_left,offset=(0 mm,3 mm))

page=canvas(size=(100 mm,60 mm))
box=rect(size=(12 mm, 10 mm),fill="#00aaaa")
first=page.add(box,target=page.top_left,offset=(5 mm,5 mm))
spare=page.add(box,target=page.top_left,offset=(60 mm,5 mm))
stem=page.add(line(dx=14 mm,dy=6 mm,line_width=2 mm),target=page.top_left,offset=(25 mm,7 mm))
merged=page.fuse(first,stem,points=(first.middle_right,stem.start),bridge_width=2 mm,junction=round,radius=1 mm,fill="#008899",border_color="none")
after=page.add(box,target=merged.bottom_left,offset=(0 mm,3 mm))

import { wedge } from "./shapes.lay"
page=canvas(size=(60 mm,50 mm))
g=group()
one=g.add(wedge,target=g.top_left)
two=g.add(wedge,target=one.top_left,offset=(4 mm,0 mm))
joint=g.fuse(one,two,fill="#dd5500",border_color="none")
page.add(g,target=page.top_left,offset=(5 mm,5 mm))
page.add(g,target=page.top_left,offset=(30 mm,5 mm))

page=canvas(size=(80 mm,50 mm))
curve=arc(radius=10 mm,start=0 deg,end=270 deg,line_color="#008899",line_width=2 mm,line_dash=[4 mm,2 mm,1 mm,2 mm])
a=page.add(curve,target=page.top_left,offset=(5 mm,5 mm))
b=page.add(rect(size=(8 mm, 8 mm),fill="#008899"),target=page.top_left,offset=(10 mm,15 mm))
joint=page.fuse(a,b,fill="#008899",border_color="none")

page=canvas(size=(60 mm,30 mm))
stem=page.add(line(dx=20 mm,dy=0 mm,line_width=2 mm,line_dash=[4 mm,2 mm,1 mm,2 mm]),target=page.top_left,offset=(5 mm,10 mm))
box=page.add(rect(size=(8 mm, 8 mm),fill="#008899"),target=page.top_left,offset=(29 mm,6 mm))
joint=page.fuse(stem,box,points=(stem.end,box.middle_left),bridge_width=2 mm,fill="#008899",border_color="none")

page=canvas(size=(50 mm,50 mm))
box=rect(size=(10 mm, 10 mm),fill="#f00")
a=page.add(box,target=page.top_left)
b=page.add(box,target=page.top_left,offset=(20 mm,0 mm))
c=page.fuse(a,b,fill="#f00",border_color="none")

page=canvas(size=(50 mm,50 mm))
box=rect(size=(10 mm, 10 mm),fill="#f00")
a=page.add(box,target=page.top_left)
b=page.add(box,target=page.top_left,offset=(20 mm,0 mm))
c=page.fuse(a,b,bridge_width=0 mm,fill="#f00",border_color="none")
